title: Understanding the Matrix Columns
text: The vectors $u_1$ and $u_2$ are columns of the matrix $U$ from the Singular Value Decomposition (SVD). Each column in $U$ is an orthonormal vector.

title: Properties of Orthonormal Vectors
text: Orthonormal vectors have a magnitude of $$1$$ and are orthogonal to each other. This means that the dot product of any two different columns in $U$ is zero.

title: Checking Validity of $u_1$ and $u_2$
text: To determine if the combination of $u_1$ and $u_2$ is valid, check if they are orthonormal. Calculate their magnitudes and dot product.

hintAnswer: Yes, both have a magnitude of $$1$$.
title: Magnitude of $u_1$ and $u_2$
text: Calculate the magnitude of $u_1$ and $u_2$. Are they equal to 1?
choices: Yes, both have a magnitude of $$1$$.

hintAnswer: Yes, the dot product is zero.
title: Dot Product of $u_1$ and $u_2$
text: Calculate the dot product of $u_1$ and $u_2$. Is it zero?
choices: Yes, the dot product is zero.

title: Conclusion on Validity
text: Since $u_1$ and $u_2$ are orthonormal, the combination is valid. Therefore, the statement is FALSE.
